This page contains an outline of the topics, content, and assignments for the semester. Note that this schedule will be updated as the semester progresses and the timeline of topics and assignments might be updated throughout the semester.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(googlesheets4)
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
gs4_deauth()
d <- read_sheet(
  "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1mMJwre7sE2RGyorwwn87cyBv6RY1woeV3pKeS_MoQz8/edit?gid=675503730#gid=675503730",
  sheet = "Schedule"
)
prepare_cutoff_date <- as.Date("2026-09-15")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| column: screen-right
d_prepared <- d |>
  filter(session != "None") |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(as.Date(map_chr(date, as.character))), #modified this as date is a list of dttm variables
    # Anchor on each week-start row so the page can auto-scroll to the
    # current week on load (see the <script> at the bottom of this file).
    week = if_else(
      is.na(week),
      NA_character_,
      paste0(
        '<span id="week-',
        date,
        '" class="week-anchor"></span>',
        week
      )
    ),
    readings = if_else(
      date > prepare_cutoff_date &
        (session %in% c("Lec", "Lab")),
      "_To be posted_",
      readings
    ),
    videos = if_else(
      date > prepare_cutoff_date &
        (session %in% c("Lec", "Lab")),
      "_To be posted_",
      videos
    ),
    #added the other & statements so that deadlines don't have "To be posted" language
    #readings = if_else(date > prepare_cutoff_date, "*To be posted*", readings) #added the other & statements so that deadlines don't have "To be posted" language
    # Materials column: one icon per linked document in the sheet's materials
    # cell, which holds <br>-separated markdown links (e.g. "[slides 01](...)
    # <br> [notes 01](...)"). Gray outline icons while unposted; filled,
    # type-specific brand colors once URLs are added to the sheet.
    materials = case_when(
      # In-class exams get no materials icon (review sessions keep theirs).
      str_detect(topic, "Exam.*In-class") ~ NA_character_,
      !is.na(materials) ~ map_chr(materials, function(cell) {
        if (is.na(cell)) {
          return(cell)
        }
        icons <- str_split_1(cell, "<br>") |>
          map_chr(function(entry) {
            entry <- str_trim(entry)
            label <- str_match(entry, "\\[([^]]*)\\]")[, 2]
            url <- str_match(entry, "\\(([^)]*)\\)")[, 2]
            # anything that isn't a markdown link passes through unchanged
            if (entry == "" || is.na(url)) {
              return(entry)
            }
            icon <- case_when(
              str_detect(label, regex("slides", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~
                "fa-file-powerpoint",
              str_detect(label, regex("notes", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~
                "fa-file-lines",
              TRUE ~ "fa-file-code"
            )
            material_type <- case_when(
              str_detect(label, regex("slides", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "slides",
              str_detect(label, regex("notes", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "notes",
              str_detect(
                label,
                regex("application exercise|\\bae\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)
              ) ~ "ae",
              str_detect(label, regex("lab", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "lab",
              str_detect(
                label,
                regex("homework|\\bhw\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)
              ) ~ "homework",
              TRUE ~ "other"
            )
            title <- if_else(is.na(label), "Materials", str_to_sentence(label))
            paste0(
              '<a href="',
              url,
              '" title="',
              title,
              '" aria-label="',
              title,
              '">',
              '<i class="fa-solid ',
              icon,
              ' materials-icon materials-icon-',
              material_type,
              '" aria-hidden="true"></i></a>'
            )
          }) |>
          keep(~ .x != "") |>
          str_c(collapse = "")
        paste0('<span class="materials-links">', icons, '</span>')
      }),
      session == "Lec" ~ paste0(
        '<span class="materials-links">',
        '<i class="fa-regular fa-file-powerpoint materials-icon-empty" ',
        'title="Slides to be posted" aria-hidden="true"></i>',
        '<i class="fa-regular fa-file-lines materials-icon-empty" ',
        'title="Notes to be posted" aria-hidden="true"></i>',
        '</span>'
      ),
      session == "Lab" ~ paste0(
        '<i class="fa-regular fa-file-code materials-icon-empty" ',
        'title="Lab materials to be posted" aria-hidden="true"></i>'
      ),
      TRUE ~ materials
    ),
    # Prefix each reading entry with a FontAwesome book icon: green for r4ds,
    # blue for ims. Cells can hold several <br>-separated entries of mixed
    # sources, so prepend per entry rather than once per cell.
    readings = map_chr(readings, function(cell) {
      if (is.na(cell)) {
        return(cell)
      }
      str_split_1(cell, "<br>") |>
        map_chr(function(entry) {
          entry <- str_trim(entry)
          # don't decorate empty entries or the "To be posted" placeholder
          if (entry == "" || str_detect(entry, "To be posted")) {
            return(entry)
          }
          icon <- case_when(
            str_detect(
              entry,
              "\\[r4ds"
            ) ~ '<i class="fa-solid fa-book reading-icon-r4ds" aria-hidden="true"></i>',
            str_detect(
              entry,
              "\\[ims"
            ) ~ '<i class="fa-solid fa-book reading-icon-ims" aria-hidden="true"></i>',
            TRUE ~ '<i class="fa-solid fa-file reading-icon-other" aria-hidden="true"></i>'
          )
          str_c(icon, entry)
        }) |>
        str_c(collapse = "<br>")
    }),
    # Prefix each video entry with a FontAwesome icon: screwdriver-wrench
    # (yellow) for "Meet the toolkit", laptop-code for "Code along", else
    # chalkboard-user. Also strip the "... :: " label from the link text.
    videos = map_chr(videos, function(cell) {
      if (is.na(cell)) {
        return(cell)
      }
      str_split_1(cell, "<br>") |>
        map_chr(function(entry) {
          entry <- str_trim(entry)
          # don't decorate empty entries or the "To be posted" placeholder
          if (entry == "" || str_detect(entry, "To be posted")) {
            return(entry)
          }
          is_toolkit <- str_detect(
            entry,
            regex("Meet the toolkit :: ", ignore_case = TRUE)
          )
          is_codealong <- str_detect(
            entry,
            regex("Code along :: ", ignore_case = TRUE)
          )
          icon <- case_when(
            is_toolkit ~ '<i class="fa-solid fa-screwdriver-wrench video-icon-toolkit" aria-hidden="true"></i>',
            is_codealong ~ '<i class="fa-solid fa-laptop-code video-icon-codealong" aria-hidden="true"></i>',
            TRUE ~ '<i class="fa-solid fa-chalkboard-user video-icon-lecture" aria-hidden="true"></i>'
          )
          entry <- str_remove(
            entry,
            regex("Meet the toolkit :: ", ignore_case = TRUE)
          )
          entry <- str_remove(
            entry,
            regex("Code along :: ", ignore_case = TRUE)
          )
          str_c(icon, entry)
        }) |>
        str_c(collapse = "<br>")
    }),
  )

# Row background colors keyed off the session type (labs vs. lectures),
# replacing the previous zebra striping. Captured before select() drops the
# session column so we can address rows by position in the gt table.
lab_rows <- which(d_prepared$session == "Lab")
lec_rows <- which(d_prepared$session == "Lec")
exam_rows <- which(d_prepared$session == "Exam")
holiday_rows <- which(d_prepared$session == "Holiday")
due_rows <- which(d_prepared$session == "Due")
review_rows <- which(d_prepared$session == "Review")


d_prepared |>
  select(week, date, materials, topic, readings, videos, due) |> #moved this down so i can use session value in above mutate readings line
  # changed this to columns want to keep (instead of which to remove)
  relocate(due, .after = videos) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_date(date, date_style = 31) |>
  sub_missing(
    columns = c(week, readings, videos, topic, materials, due),
    missing_text = ""
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c(week, materials)
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "right",
    columns = c(date)
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = c(topic, readings, videos, due)
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(
      color = "#b4b4b4"
    ),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = readings,
      rows = str_detect(readings, "To be posted")
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(
      color = "#b4b4b4"
    ),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = videos,
      rows = str_detect(videos, "To be posted")
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(
      sides = "right",
      color = "#D3D3D3",
      style = "solid"
    ),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = c(date, readings, videos, topic)
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    # add lines between weeks of the semester
    style = cell_borders(
      sides = "top",
      color = "black",
      weight = px(2),
      style = "solid"
    ),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = everything(),
      rows = !is.na(week)
      # puts black line above rows where certain keywords are detected in certain columns
    )
  ) |>
  fmt_markdown(
    columns = c(week, topic, readings, videos, materials, due)
  ) |>
  tab_options(table.width = pct(98), table.align = 'left') |>
  cols_width(
    week ~ pct(2),
    date ~ pct(9),
    topic ~ pct(24),
    materials ~ pct(5),
    readings ~ pct(15),
    videos ~ pct(20),
    due ~ pct(15)
  ) |>
  cols_label_with(fn = function(x) {
    janitor::make_clean_names(x, case = "title") |>
      toupper() |>
      stringr::str_replace_all("^|$", "**") |>
      md()
  }) |>
  cols_label(materials = "") |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = 13) |>
  # Color rows by session type instead of zebra striping.
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#ffffff"), # white for lectures
    locations = cells_body(rows = lec_rows)
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#13395520"), # light blue for labs
    locations = cells_body(rows = lab_rows)
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#83807B20"), # light gray for holidays
    locations = cells_body(rows = holiday_rows)
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#B9839140"), # light pink for exams
    locations = cells_body(rows = exam_rows)
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#B9839110"), # lighter pink for review
    locations = cells_body(rows = review_rows)
  )
```

```{=html}
<script>
// Scroll to the current week on load: find the latest week-start anchor
// (id="week-YYYY-MM-DD") whose date is on or before today, then jump to it.
// Skipped when the URL already targets a specific anchor (#...).
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  if (window.location.hash) return;

  var anchors = Array.prototype.slice.call(
    document.querySelectorAll(".week-anchor")
  );
  if (!anchors.length) return;

  var now = new Date();
  var today = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());

  var target = null;
  anchors.forEach(function (a) {
    var parts = a.id.replace("week-", "").split("-");
    var d = new Date(+parts[0], +parts[1] - 1, +parts[2]);
    if (d <= today) target = a;
  });

  if (target) {
    target.scrollIntoView({ block: "start" });
  }
});
</script>
```
